description:
A dental researcher needs to isolate only the highest-density structures (enamel, petrous bone, metal) from the loaded CT Cranium scan. 

1. Create a new segmentation mask using the **custom** threshold range **1500 to 3071 HU** (do not use a preset).
2. Generate a 3D surface from this mask.
3. Export the surface as a binary STL file to `/home/ga/Documents/dense_structures.stl`.
4. Read the surface volume (mL) from the InVesalius interface and write it to a text file at `/home/ga/Documents/dense_volume_report.txt` (format: "Volume: X.X mL").
5. Save the project to `/home/ga/Documents/dense_analysis.inv3`.

Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
